visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with messy dark hair wearing a light beige short-sleeved button-up shirt sits at a light-colored wooden table. He stares at a silver laptop with a look of extreme surprise, eyes wide and mouth slightly open. The background is a bright indoor living room with a brown leather couch and white curtains. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a smartphone screen held in the man's hands. The screen displays a black-and-white promotional poster for G-Dragon's 'Übermensch' world tour, featuring a high-contrast portrait. Visible text mentions 'FR 1 + 12 SA PRESALE OPEN' and shows a 'SPONSORED BY SAMSUNG' logo. (3) A woman with long black hair, wearing a green surgical mask and a black shirt, is seated at a white desk with a computer monitor. She turns her head to speak to the man while her hands rest on a white keyboard. The setting is a cluttered but bright home office with figurines on shelves. (4) The man is now sitting on a white carpeted floor next to a leather couch. He is physically wringing out the hem of his beige shirt, from which clear water is actively dripping and splashing onto the floor. He looks at his wet clothes with a serious expression. (5) In a series of jump cuts, the man transforms his appearance. He puts on a brown textured suit jacket over a multi-colored striped shirt. He then wraps a large red, white, and brown floral scarf around his head and neck, tying it under his chin, and puts on dark sunglasses. (6) The man is shown in a full-body shot standing in the living room, fully dressed in the brown suit and headscarf. A red surgical mask is added over his face, and then a pixelated mosaic overlay completely obscures his face. He strikes a confident pose with his hands in his pockets. (7) The man, still wearing the full suit, headscarf, sunglasses, red mask, and pixelated face overlay, sits back at the wooden table and types on the silver laptop. He appears to be working diligently while completely disguised in this elaborate, bulky outfit. (8) A wide shot of the office shows the woman working at her desk and another male colleague in the background. Yellow variety-show style text captions appear on the screen over the scene. The lighting is bright and even throughout the workspace.
